# Build spec · website of the 3D studio (no name yet)

Owner of decisions: this document. Inputs it resolves: `docs/research/01..07`, `docs/design/DESIGN-RULEBOOK.md`
(+ `tokens.css`, `design-lint.mjs`), `docs/build/CONTENT-SCHEMA.md`. When a research doc and this spec disagree,
**this spec wins**. When the rulebook and this spec disagree on visual matters, **the rulebook wins** (except
where this spec explicitly overrides it).

## 0. Decisions (final)

| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| Stack | Static site generated by a zero-runtime-dependency Node ≥ 20 ESM generator (`build/build.mjs`) into `dist/`. Dev deps allowed: `sharp`, `@gltf-transform/*`, `uqr` (QR at build). No frameworks, no bundler, no Tailwind, no GSAP, no Lenis. Deployed on Netlify. |
| Languages | Spanish at `/`, English under `/en/` (reduced set). Pairing, slugs, templates and parents come ONLY from `build/data/routes.mjs`. hreflang only for pairs that exist, plus `x-default` → EN twin (or ES when no EN twin). |
| Art direction | **B2 "Plano"** from the rulebook: tokens `docs/design/tokens.css` copied verbatim to `src/css/00-tokens.css` (only file with colour literals). Archivo (variable, self-hosted) + Geist Mono. Sharp system (0/2px), no shadows on content, no blur, no pills, añil accent `#2D4596`. Light default, dark via `prefers-color-scheme`. |
| Brand | Placeholder text wordmark `site.brand.name` ("Estudio 3D"), fixed logo slot. Content uses `{{brand}}`. While `hasPlaceholders()` is true: every page `noindex, follow`, robots.txt still open (so previews are safe), build prints a loud warning, and the Netlify **production** context fails unless `ALLOW_PLACEHOLDERS=1`. |
| Prices | `build/data/pricing.mjs` (PROPOSAL, `confirmed:false`). Everything price-related reads from it (tokens, schema Offers, calculator, llms.txt). Show "+ IVA / + VAT". |
| 3D | Self-hosted `@google/model-viewer` 4.3.1 in `public/lib/model-viewer/`, **never** in the initial HTML: dynamically imported on intent. Web model `/models/villa.glb` (2.99 MB, meshopt + webp). iOS AR via `ios-src` = `/models/villa_maqueta_1a20.usdz` + separate "Tamaño real" `<a rel="ar">` to `/models/villa_tamano_real.usdz`. Android via our own Scene Viewer intent URLs to `villa-ar-maqueta.glb` / `villa-ar.glb` (model-viewer `ar-modes="webxr quick-look"`, NOT scene-viewer: it cannot read meshopt). See `docs/research/06-3d-ar-pipeline.md`. |
| Forms | Netlify Forms, form name `presupuesto`, multipart with file upload (plan), honeypot, RGPD checkbox, hidden UTM/referrer/landing fields, "¿Cómo nos conociste?" with ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/Claude/Copilot/Google/… options. Success → `/gracias/` or `/en/thanks/`. Preselect `?servicio=`. |
| Analytics | None by default (`site.analytics = null`). If configured: cookieless Plausible only. No cookie banner needed; cookie policy states it. |
| Hashing | All CSS/JS/fonts/images under `/assets/` and `/lib/` get content-hashed filenames at build and `Cache-Control: immutable, 1 year`. HTML `max-age=0, must-revalidate`. `/models/*` unhashed (stable URLs for schema/AR), `max-age=86400, stale-while-revalidate=604800`. No `?v=` query strings. |
| Dates | `dateModified` from content files, never the build date. Sitemap `lastmod` = content `dateModified`. |

## 1. Repository layout

```
build/
  build.mjs                 ENGINE  entry: load → validate → assets → render → machine outputs → report
  check.mjs                 GEO     post-build QA (SEO/GEO/a11y-lint/perf budgets) + runs scripts/design-lint.mjs
  validate-content.mjs      (exists) content contract validator; build.mjs must run the same checks and fail on errors
  serve.mjs                 ENGINE  preview server for dist/ (reuse scripts/serve.mjs logic; trailing slash, real 404, MIME for glb/usdz/avif/md)
  data/                     shared data: site, routes, pricing, villa, process, deliverables (exist) · ui.mjs (ENGINE) · glossary.mjs (CONTENT)
  content/<id>.mjs          CONTENT pages (see CONTENT-SCHEMA.md)
  generated/images.json     ASSETS image manifest (committed)
  lib/
    context.mjs             ENGINE  ctx factory (§3)
    md.mjs                  ENGINE  md-lite → HTML, token + link resolution
    assets.mjs              ENGINE  hashing, asset(), img()/picture()
    layout.mjs              ENGINE  <head>, header, footer, breadcrumbs, bottom bar
    blocks.mjs              ENGINE  block renderers (delegates viewer/ar/formats/embedCode to viewer.mjs)
    components.mjs          ENGINE  cajetín, compare slider, despiece, calculator, form, faq, cta, related, tables
    viewer.mjs              VIEWER  renderViewerBand, renderViewerApp, renderArBlock, renderFormats, renderEmbedCode, arLinks
    schema.mjs              GEO     schemaGraph(entry, ctx) → JSON-LD @graph nodes
    markdown.mjs            GEO     blocksToMarkdown(entry, ctx) for index.md mirrors and llms-full.txt
    machine.mjs             GEO     writeMachineOutputs(entries, env): robots, sitemaps, llms*, md mirrors, feeds, indexnow, _headers, _redirects
  templates/<name>.mjs      ENGINE (home, hub, service, audience, zone, case, process, pricing, guide, glossary, faq, about, contact, thanks, legal, notfound) · VIEWER (ar, embed)
src/
  css/00-tokens.css … 90-utilities.css   concatenated in filename order into one site.css (ENGINE owns all but 50-viewer.css = VIEWER)
  js/main.js                ENGINE  ≤ 15 KB min: nav, reveals, faq, compare slider, despiece fallback, calculator, form enhancements, copy buttons
  js/viewer.js              VIEWER  module, loaded only on pages with a viewer/ar block; dynamic-imports model-viewer
public/                     copied to dist/ (assets hashed): assets/fonts, assets/img, lib/model-viewer, models, favicons
scripts/
  3d/*                      (exists) model pipeline
  images.mjs                ASSETS  renders → AVIF/WebP variants + OG crops + images.json
  fonts/                    ASSETS  font subsetting recipe (python fontTools)
  design-lint.mjs           GEO     copy of docs/design/design-lint.mjs adapted to dist/
  indexnow.mjs              GEO     manual "submit all" script
netlify/
  functions/deploy-succeeded.mjs   GEO  IndexNow ping of changed URLs (production only)
  edge-functions/markdown.js       GEO  Accept: text/markdown negotiation
netlify.toml                GEO
```

## 2. Build pipeline (`npm run build` = `node build/build.mjs`)

1. Load `site`, `routes`, data modules, every `build/content/<id>.mjs`. Run the content validator logic; **errors abort**. Pages whose content file is missing are skipped with a warning (so partial builds work during development) unless `STRICT=1`.
2. Assets: read `src/css/*.css` in name order → concatenate → minify (strip comments/whitespace safely) → rewrite `url(/assets/…)` to hashed names → `dist/assets/css/site.<hash8>.css`. `src/js/*.js` → minify lightly (or copy) → `dist/assets/js/<name>.<hash8>.js`. Copy `public/**` to `dist/**`, renaming files under `public/assets/**` and `public/lib/**` to `<name>.<hash8>.<ext>`; keep an `assetMap` (original public path → hashed path). `/models/**` and favicons at root are copied as is.
3. Render: for each route × language with content, build `ctx` (§3), call the template, wrap in the layout, collect a **registry entry** (§5). Also render `404.html` (template `notfound`, noindex).
4. Machine outputs: `writeMachineOutputs(entries, env)` from `build/lib/machine.mjs`.
5. Report: page count per language, total HTML/CSS/JS/fonts/img weight of the home, placeholders warning, pricing-not-confirmed warning.

`npm run check` runs `build/check.mjs` on `dist/` (0 errors required). Netlify build command: `npm run build && npm run check`.

## 3. Render context (`build/lib/context.mjs`)

```js
ctx = {
  lang, route, doc, page /* = doc[lang] */, site, ui /* UI[lang] */, entryPath /* route[lang] */,
  t(key),                         // ui string by dotted key; throws on missing
  href(id, anchor?),              // path of page id in ctx.lang (throws if missing)
  abs(path),                      // site.domain + path
  asset(publicPath),              // hashed URL of a public asset
  img(name, { alt, sizes, eager, className, variant }), // <picture> from images.json: AVIF + WebP srcset, width/height, loading/decoding, fetchpriority only when eager
  md(str), mdInline(str),         // md-lite → HTML with tokens and links resolved (links: @id → href, @glosario#x → glossary anchor)
  tok(str),                       // tokens resolved, markdown stripped → plain text (for meta, schema, llms)
  price(packId, tier?), extra(id), delivery(packId), fmtNumber(n, decimals?), fmtBytes(bytes),
  needs: Set,                     // 'viewer' | 'slider' | 'calculator' | 'form' | 'despiece' → drives which JS/CSS hooks load
}
```

Templates: `export default function render(ctx) { return { main, layout: 'default' | 'bare', bodyClass } }`.

## 4. Layout (`build/lib/layout.mjs`)

`<head>` order: charset, viewport (`width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover`, never disable zoom), title
(`${page.title} | ${brand}` unless it contains `{{brand}}`), description, robots (`noindex, follow` if placeholders or
`route.index === false`; else `index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1`),
canonical, hreflang alternates, OG/Twitter (og:type website/article, og:image = 1200×630 JPG crop of `doc.image`),
`theme-color` light/dark, `color-scheme`, preload **only** the Archivo woff2 (`crossorigin`), the CSS link, icons +
manifest, `<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="…/index.md">` for indexable pages, inline
`<script>document.documentElement.classList.add('js')</script>`, JSON-LD `<script type="application/ld+json">` with
`{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[…]}` from `schemaGraph()` (escape `<`). `main.js` with `defer`.
`viewer.js` as `type="module"` only when `ctx.needs.has('viewer')`, preceded by the inline
`self.ModelViewerElement = { meshoptDecoderLocation: '<hashed meshopt path>' }` snippet.

`<body>`: skip link → header (logo slot with text wordmark, nav: Servicios · Cómo funciona · Precios · La villa en 3D · Guías,
language switch to the twin or the other home, primary CTA "Pide tu demo"; mobile: menu button with accessible
disclosure + focus management) → breadcrumbs (all pages except home) → `<main id="main">` → footer (entity sentence,
contact details **in text**: email, phone, WhatsApp; columns: Servicios, Soluciones, Recursos (guías, glosario, FAQ, caso),
Estudio (sobre nosotros, contacto, zonas), Legal; language link; © year brand) → mobile bottom bar (Pide tu demo +
Escribir por WhatsApp, respects safe-area, hidden ≥ 768px).

CTA vocabulary (lint-enforced): "Pide tu demo" / "Get your demo" (→ contacto), "Ver la villa en 3D" / "View the villa in 3D"
(→ caso-villa#visor or #demo on home), "Ver en tu salón" / "View in your room" (AR), "Calcular precio" / "Estimate price",
"Enviar solicitud" / "Send request", "Escribir por WhatsApp" / "Message on WhatsApp" (neutral styling, no WhatsApp green).

## 5. Registry entry (engine → GEO)

```js
{
  id, lang, template, path, url, index /* bool: indexable */,
  alternates /* { es?: path, en?: path, 'x-default': path } */,
  title /* full, with brand */, description, h1, lead /* plain */, facts /* [[k,v]] plain */,
  breadcrumbs /* [{ name, path }] */, parentId,
  image /* { name, url (abs OG jpg), width: 1200, height: 630, alt } */,
  images /* [{ url (abs, largest webp or jpg), caption, alt }] for the image sitemap */,
  datePublished, dateModified,
  faq /* [{ q, a }] plain, the FAQ actually rendered on the page (incl. faqGroups flattened) */,
  blocks /* raw content blocks */, page /* raw doc[lang] */, doc,
  html, wordCount,
  ctx /* the render ctx (for md/tok/href in markdown.mjs) */,
}
```

## 6. Templates (section order)

- **home** (rulebook C5): hero split 5/7 (H1 ≤ 36 chars, lead, "Pide tu demo" + "Ver la villa en 3D"; visual = `villa_maqueta_iso` RGBA on `--color-stage`, eager/fetchpriority=high, caption "Render generado a partir del plano 2D, sin fotos") → cajetín (facts) → content blocks in order (expected: compare, deliverables, process[despiece], viewer (id `demo`), audiences, pricing[excerpt] + calculator, faq, contactForm). No closing CTA (the form is the end). 
- **hub**: text hero → cajetín optional → blocks (typically `services`/`pages`/`comingSoon`) → related → closing CTA.
- **service / audience / zone**: text hero with optional side figure (`page.hero`) → cajetín → blocks → FAQ (if not placed) → related → closing CTA (preselected service).
- **case** (`caso-villa`): H1 + lead → **viewer app** (`renderViewerApp`, id `visor`, poster eager) → cajetín → blocks (specs, gallery, timeline via steps, notice callout, embedCode, ar…) → FAQ → related → CTA "Quiero esto para mi promoción".
- **process**: text hero → cajetín → blocks (process[despiece], needs, …) → FAQ → CTA. Emits HowTo schema.
- **pricing**: text hero → cajetín → blocks (pricing[full], calculator, guarantees, tables…) → FAQ → CTA.
- **guide**: article layout, 66ch column, visible "Actualizado el <time>" + author line ("Equipo de {{brand}}"), auto table of contents from block `h2`s (≥ 4), blocks, FAQ, sources, related, CTA.
- **glossary**: A–Z index + one `<section id="<term id>">` per term (term H2, definition first sentence ≤ 40 words, body, related link). DefinedTermSet schema.
- **faq**: grouped `<details>` (first 3 of each group open), FAQPage schema.
- **about**: text hero → blocks → CTA. AboutPage schema.
- **contact**: H1 + lead → form (`contactForm`) + alternatives (WhatsApp, email, phone, booking if set) → FAQ. ContactPage schema.
- **thanks**: noindex, confirmation, next steps, links to caso-villa and guías.
- **legal**: plain reading layout, prose blocks.
- **notfound**: 404, noindex, search-free: links to home, servicios, caso, contacto.
- **ar** (VIEWER): noindex landing for QR codes: platform-detected big buttons "Maqueta 1:20 sobre la mesa" / "Tamaño real" + instructions + link to the case.
- **embed** (VIEWER): `layout: 'bare'`, noindex, full-viewport viewer app for iframes (`frame-ancestors *`), small "powered by" text link to the home.

## 7. Components (ENGINE unless noted) · behaviour contracts

- **Cajetín** (facts): `<dl class="cajetin">` grid styled as an architectural title block; values in tabular figures; dimension-line draw animation once (reduced motion: static).
- **Compare slider**: two registered images (`villa_plano_lineas` left/under, `villa_planta_cenital_opaco` over) clipped by a native `<input type="range">` (keyboard, aria-label, aria-valuetext "Plano 2D 50 %"); labels "Plano 2D" / "Modelo 3D"; one-time peek animation 50→38→50 % on first view (not under reduced motion); aspect-ratio 2400/3700 (portrait) with a landscape crop on wide screens is allowed via object-position.
- **Despiece**: 3 RGBA layers `villa_despiece_1..3` (assets) stacked; CSS scroll-driven `animation-timeline: view()` inside `@supports`, IntersectionObserver fallback, static assembled image under reduced motion; captions tied to the 5 process steps. If the layer images are missing in images.json, fall back to `villa_maqueta_iso` with the steps list (no broken images).
- **Pricing**: packs as a table on mobile-friendly layout (no 3 equal cards: featured pack wider), tiers table, extras table, volume pack, guarantees, VAT note, "Precios propuestos" is NOT shown publicly (the `confirmed` flag only affects the build warning).
- **Calculator**: stepper (− / number input / +), live total with `aria-live="polite"`, per-unit price from `pricing.calculator.steps`, "+ IVA" and "IVA incluido" lines, CTA "Pide tu demo" passing `?servicio=maqueta&unidades=N`. Works without JS as a static table of the steps.
- **Form**: labels for every field (explicit `for`/`id`), `autocomplete` attributes, `inputmode`, required markers in text, inline validation messages `aria-live`, file input accepts `.pdf,.jpg,.jpeg,.png,.dwg,.dxf` (≤ 8 MB note + "o pega un enlace de descarga"), RGPD checkbox linking to privacy, honeypot `bot-field` hidden, `data-netlify="true"`, `netlify-honeypot="bot-field"`, `enctype="multipart/form-data"`, hidden `form-name`, hidden `utm_source/utm_medium/utm_campaign/referrer/landing` filled by JS, WebMCP attributes `toolname="solicitar_presupuesto"` + `tooldescription`, submit button "Enviar solicitud" with pending state.
- **FAQ**: native `<details>`/`<summary>` (first 3 open), full answers in the served HTML.
- **Related**: index list ("Sigue leyendo"), card title + summary.
- **Tables**: real `<table>` with caption, `scope`, horizontal scroll wrapper with focusable region + label on small screens.
- **Date line**: "Actualizado el <time datetime>28 sep 2026</time>" on every indexable page (footer of main).
- **Reveals**: one IntersectionObserver; content hidden only when `html.js` and no reduced motion; nothing in the hero animates on load.

## 8. Viewer (VIEWER agent) · contracts

Inputs: `build/data/villa.mjs`, `docs/research/06-3d-ar-pipeline.md` (read it fully), the original viewer in
`C:\Users\aissa\.claude\projects\E--ProyectosRealStateBlender\d3915552-e6e3-4554-af87-43a5635fa851\tool-results\artifact-6cfc14c4-1790557968-bf18.html` (lines 400-683: room list, hotspots, tour, cut, camera presets, AR hint, light slider; reuse its logic, restyle to B2).

- `renderViewerBand(ctx, block)`: full-bleed `--color-stage` band. Server HTML contains: `<model-viewer loading="lazy" reveal="manual" …>` with `<picture slot="poster">` (poster image `villa_viewer_poster` if present else `villa_maqueta_iso`), the room list as real HTML (`<ol>` with names and m², so crawlers see it), a primary button "Explorar en 3D (3,1 MB)" and "Ver en tu salón". No model-viewer JS until intent (click/focus/pointerenter on the band, or IntersectionObserver + idle when not Save-Data/2G). Hotspots/labels only after load.
- `renderViewerApp(ctx)`: the full app (case page + embed): stage + room rail (12 rooms with m², active state), toolbar (Vista general, Planta, Recorrido/Pausar, Maqueta 1,15 m ↔ Muros completos 2,60 m, Luz, zoom), room note `aria-live`, AR buttons, gesture hint, progress bar with size, error state with retry, keyboard support.
- `renderArBlock(ctx, block)`: iPhone/iPad `<a rel="ar" href="/models/villa_maqueta_1a20.usdz#canonicalWebPageURL=…&callToAction=…"><img …></a>` (rel=ar requires a single img child) + "Tamaño real" link with `#allowsContentScaling=0`; Android intent links (Scene Viewer) with fallback URL; desktop (`(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)`): QR code SVG generated at build with `uqr` pointing to `abs(href('ar-villa'))?utm_source=qr&utm_medium=web`, plus instructions. Include the file sizes.
- `renderFormats(ctx, block)`: compatibility table (Dispositivo · Cómo se abre · Formato · Tamaño) from villa.files.
- `renderEmbedCode(ctx, block)`: `<pre><code>` iframe snippet (`<iframe src="{abs(embed-villa)}" … allow="xr-spatial-tracking; fullscreen" loading="lazy" title="…">`) + copy button.
- `src/js/viewer.js`: dynamic `import(mvUrl)` (hashed URL from a `data-mv` attribute), sets meshopt decoder location, applies the cut on `load` (filter `mv.model.materials` by `name.endsWith('_Alto')`, alpha MASK 0.5, baseColor alpha 0; restore on "Muros completos"), room focus (cameraTarget/cameraOrbit as the original), guided tour (pausable, 4.2 s/step, 6 s reduced motion, `jumpCameraToGoal` under reduced motion), exposure control, AR status handling (`quick-look-button-tapped` → open the contact page), fails gracefully (console-clean).
- i18n: all viewer strings in `build/data/ui.mjs` under `viewer.*` (coordinate with ENGINE: VIEWER may add its keys in a separate `build/data/ui-viewer.mjs` that ui.mjs spreads in).
- CSS: `src/css/50-viewer.css` using only tokens.

## 9. GEO / machine outputs (GEO agent) · contracts

Read `docs/research/04-geo-2026.md` fully (robots §3, llms §4, IndexNow §5, schema §6, checklist §11) and
`docs/research/05-playbook-malaga.md` §5 (QA checks).

- `schemaGraph(entry, ctx)`: stable `@id`s: `${domain}/#organization` (ProfessionalService + Organization data: name, url, logo if any, description = entity, areaServed with Wikidata `sameAs` (Marbella Q484799, Málaga Q8851, Costa del Sol Q215254, Spain Q29), knowsAbout (augmented reality Q254183, glTF Q28135989, 3D rendering Q16911860, virtual home staging Q28401684, floor plan Q18965), contactPoint, email/telephone, sameAs from site.sameAs, knowsLanguage), `${domain}/#website` (WebSite, inLanguage es/en, publisher), per page `WebPage` subtype (AboutPage/ContactPage/FAQPage/CollectionPage…) with `isPartOf`, `about`, `primaryImageOfPage`, `dateModified`, `inLanguage`, `speakable` (`.lead`, `.cajetin`), `BreadcrumbList`. Service pages: `Service` + `Offer`/`UnitPriceSpecification` (VAT excluded, `valueAddedTaxIncluded:false`) from the route's `pack`. Pricing: `OfferCatalog`. Case: `CreativeWork`/`Article` + **`3DModel`** with `encoding` MediaObjects (`model/gltf-binary` villa.glb, `model/vnd.usdz+zip` usdz, contentSize), `ImageObject`s for renders. Guides: `Article` (author/publisher = organization, dates, image). Process: `HowTo` (steps from process.mjs). Glossary: `DefinedTermSet` + `DefinedTerm`s. FAQ: `FAQPage` wherever a FAQ is rendered (text must equal the visible text). Full Organization only on home/about/contact; elsewhere reference by `@id`.
- `writeMachineOutputs(entries, env)`: `robots.txt` generated from ONE rules array (all search + AI bots allowed; `Disallow: /models/` and `/embed/` for all; block only Bytespider; `Sitemap:` line; `Content-Signal` comment line), `sitemap.xml` as a sitemap index → `sitemap-pages.xml` (hreflang alternates, lastmod = dateModified, only indexable pages) + `sitemap-images.xml`, `llms.txt` (template in 04 §4.3, bilingual, prices from pricing.mjs, key facts from villa.mjs, links only to indexable URLs), `llms-full.txt` (ES) + `en/llms-full.txt` (EN): commercial pages and guides as Markdown, ≤ 400 KB each (hubs/legal stay in llms.txt and their index.md), `<path>index.md` mirror per indexable page (Markdown from blocks; tokens/links resolved to absolute URLs), `feed.xml` + `en/feed.xml` (guides), `<indexNowKey>.txt`, `indexnow-manifest.json` (url → sha256 of the page's markdown) + `indexnow-pending.json` (diff vs the live manifest fetched from `site.domain` when reachable; all URLs otherwise), `_headers` (security: HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy allowing `xr-spatial-tracking=(self)`, COOP; **CSP** `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' <sha256 of inline scripts or 'unsafe-inline' only if unavoidable>; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' data: blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'; form-action 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'` (compute hashes of the inline scripts the layout emits), `frame-ancestors *` + `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` on `/embed/*`, `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` on `*.md`, `/llms*.txt`, indexnow files, MIME + CORS + cache for `/models/*`, immutable for `/assets/*` and `/lib/*`), `_redirects` or netlify.toml redirects from `routes.mjs` `redirects`, `site.webmanifest`.
- `netlify.toml`: build `npm run build && npm run check`, publish `dist`, `[build.processing.html] pretty_urls = false`, functions + edge functions dirs, Node 20, NO catch-all redirect, edge function `markdown` declares its own routing in the function file (`config`), gated by the `accept` header containing `text/markdown`. Node 24 in netlify.toml (tested version).
- `netlify/functions/deploy-succeeded.mjs`: production only (`CONTEXT`), reads `indexnow-pending.json` from the deploy URL, POSTs to `https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow` (batch ≤ 10,000), logs result; never throws.
- `build/check.mjs`: every malagatransfer check + the 25 from 05 §5.3 + 04 §11 checks: broken internal links/assets/srcset, one h1, heading order, canonical present and self-referencing, hreflang reciprocity, x-default, unique titles/descriptions (lengths as errors: title ≤ 70, description 70-160), JSON-LD parses + required fields per type + @id references resolve + FAQ JSON-LD text equals visible text, no `undefined|NaN|[object Object]|{{`, img alt + width/height, one `fetchpriority="high"` max, orphans (every indexable page linked from ≥ 1 other page), sitemap URLs exist and are indexable, llms.txt links resolve, index.md for every indexable page, robots invariants, `_headers` sanity, budgets (home HTML ≤ 60 KB, CSS ≤ 40 KB, initial JS ≤ 30 KB, fonts ≤ 110 KB, LCP image ≤ 150 KB), no request to model-viewer/GLB in initial HTML, placeholders report. Then runs `node scripts/design-lint.mjs dist` and merges its result. Exit 1 on errors.

## 10. Assets (ASSETS agent) · contracts

- **Fonts** → `public/assets/fonts/archivo-var.woff2` (Archivo variable, wdth 100-125, wght 400-650, Latin + ES/EN glyphs incl. ñ á é í ó ú ü ¿ ¡ « » “ ” ² × € ≈ ·, features kern liga tnum lnum case) and `public/assets/fonts/geist-mono-var.woff2` (wght 400-500). Follow rulebook Appendix 1 (fontTools is installed in the user's Python). Licences (OFL) in `public/assets/fonts/LICENSES.md`. Verify the fallback metrics in tokens.css still match (adjust if needed).
- **Images** → `scripts/images.mjs` (sharp): for every PNG in `source/villa3d/renders/` produce AVIF (quality tuned, alpha kept for RGBA) and WebP at widths `[480, 800, 1200, 1600, 2400]` (only ≤ source width) into `public/assets/img/<name>-<w>.<ext>`, plus a 1200×630 JPG OG crop per image into `public/assets/img/og/<name>.jpg` (≤ 150 KB), plus a tiny blurred placeholder. Write `build/generated/images.json`:
  `{ "<name>": { "width": 2800, "height": 1800, "alpha": true, "widths": [480, …], "formats": ["avif","webp"], "path": "/assets/img/<name>-{w}.{ext}", "fallback": "/assets/img/<name>-1200.webp", "og": "/assets/img/og/<name>.jpg", "placeholder": "data:image/webp;base64,…", "bytes": { "avif-1600": 123456, … } } }`.
  Budget: `villa_maqueta_iso` AVIF at 1200w ≤ 120 KB (it is the LCP). Hero preload is NOT used (the `<img>` with `fetchpriority="high"` is enough).
- **Despiece layers**: extend `source/villa3d/blender/villa_render.py` (or a new script) to render 3 pixel-registered RGBA layers from the hero iso camera at 1600×1030: (1) floor slabs + line plan feel (floors only, no walls/furniture), (2) walls + doors/windows (cut at 1.15 m), (3) furniture + plants. Name them `villa_despiece_1..3.png` in `source/villa3d/renders/`; run images.mjs again. Total AVIF at 1200w ≤ 180 KB.
- **Viewer poster**: capture `villa_viewer_poster.png` (RGBA, 1600×1100) from `<model-viewer>` with the site's default camera (`villa.viewer.cameraOrbit`, FOV 30°, AgX, cut applied, transparent background) using playwright-cli + `mv.toBlob()`, so the poster→live swap is invisible. Put it in `source/villa3d/renders/`.
- **Real-size USDZ fix**: produce `public/models/villa_tamano_real.usdz` where the finished floor is at y = 0 and the `Base_Maqueta` block is removed (so both origin-anchoring and bbox-anchoring put the floor on the real ground), normals as JPEG 1024 to cut size; keep the original in `source/villa3d/ar/`. Update `bytes` in `build/data/villa.mjs` if sizes change. Same size check for the 1:20 USDZ. Document untested-on-device status.
- **Favicons**: flat añil square SVG + `favicon.ico` (32), `apple-touch-icon.png` (180), `icon-192.png`, `icon-512.png` in `public/`.
- **Optional (if time allows)**: 8 s turntable loop of the maqueta (EEVEE or model-viewer frame capture + ffmpeg, 1280×800, H.264 MP4 ≤ 2 MB + WebM) in `public/assets/video/villa-turntable.{mp4,webm}` + poster; add to images/video manifest `build/generated/videos.json`.

## 11. Performance budgets (mobile, slow 4G, from the rulebook §A12)

LCP < 2.0 s, CLS < 0.05, TBT < 150 ms · home HTML ≤ 60 KB · CSS ≤ 40 KB · initial JS ≤ 30 KB (target 15) · fonts ≤ 110 KB ·
LCP image ≤ 120 KB · no third-party request before interaction · model-viewer/GLB never before intent.

the viewer loads on click with no console errors and the cut works · Lighthouse mobile ≥ 95 in all categories on home and a service page.
